description: Cliff Groh is a lifelong Alaskan running in the newly created House District 18. Cliff is co-creator of the Permanent Fund Dividend and is running to protect it. Cliff has studied Alaska's fiscal issues for 40 years and has helped bring in billions in state revenue through oil tax reform.
